EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Documents required for your Request
Dear Valued customer,
We acknowledge your recent notification regarding the passing of the ila Bank Account holder. Please accept our condolences for your loss.
To proceed with the necessary administrative steps, we kindly request the following information:
1. A certified copy of the death certificate. 2. Power of Attorney letter/ wealth distribution letter.
Once we receive this information, we will update our records accordingly. If you have any questions or require further assistance, please feel free to call us on +973 17123456 or email us on support@ilabank.com
